plugins.name: squad
plugins.description: Build Squad's Claude Code adapter: five specialized engineering roles, conversational specs, a security hook, and define/build/fix/refactor/review pipelines.

plugins.name: build-squad
plugins.description: Five-role engineering squad for Codex: disciplined delivery pipelines, specialized agents, and a safety guard.

skills.name: squad-breaking-change
skills.description: Apply when changing public APIs, database schemas, serialized or persisted formats, generated contracts, or behavior consumed by other systems. Requires an explicit, reversible contract transition.
skills.description_zh: 在修改公开 API、数据库结构、持久格式、生成契约或外部消费行为时，要求明确且可逆的契约过渡。

skills.name: squad-build
skills.description: Delivery pipeline for a closed specification. Validates the contract, delegates UX/development/testing/audit/documentation in bounded stages, and verifies each acceptance criterion.
skills.description_zh: 依据已封闭规格交付，验证契约，在限定阶段委派 UX、开发、测试、审计和文档，并验证每个验收条件。

skills.name: squad-define
skills.description: Conversational specification mode for a feature, product idea, or existing spec. Interviews the user until the scope closes, then writes a verifiable implementation contract for squad-build.
skills.description_zh: 通过访谈明确功能、产品或已有规格的范围，形成可验证实施契约供 squad-build 使用。

skills.name: squad-final-validation
skills.description: Proportional final validation policy for builds, tests, lint, type checks, generation, configuration, and documentation. Selects the smallest sufficient documented targets and runs tests sequentially by default.
skills.description_zh: 按变更风险选择充分且最小的已记录构建、测试、lint、类型、生成、配置及文档验证目标，默认顺序运行测试。

skills.name: squad-fix
skills.description: Reproduce-first bug-fix pipeline. Captures a defect in a failing test before production changes, verifies the minimal fix, and scans for sibling occurrences.
skills.description_zh: 先以失败测试记录缺陷再修改生产代码，验证最小修复并扫描同类位置的复现优先修复流程。

skills.name: squad-refactor
skills.description: Behavior-preserving restructuring pipeline. Freezes existing test results as the invariant, delegates implementation and audit, and rejects hidden behavior changes.
skills.description_zh: 保持行为的重构流程，冻结既有测试作为不变量，委派实现与审计，拒绝隐含行为变更。

skills.name: squad-review
skills.description: Read-only team review of a diff, branch, or PR. Merges security, contract, coverage, architecture, and UX findings into a severity-ranked verdict without modifying files.
skills.description_zh: 只读团队评审差异、分支或 PR，合并安全、契约、覆盖、架构和 UX 发现，按严重程度给出结论，不修改文件。

skills.name: squad-semantic-architecture
skills.description: Apply to lifecycle states, active/inactive or archived resources, management versus operational lists, shared selectors, state-dependent writes, and reused operational filters. Requires semantic architecture rather than copied filtering logic.
skills.description_zh: 处理生命周期、启停归档、管理与操作列表、共享选择器及依状态写入的语义架构，要求共享语义而非复制过滤逻辑。

skills.name: breaking-change
skills.description: Apply when a task changes a public API, endpoint signature or response shape, database schema, serialized or persisted format, event/message contract, or any interface other code or systems consume. Enforces closing the transition safely — consumer inventory, compatibility decision (compatible extension / expand–contract / explicit versioning), migration and backfill plan, deprecation path, and a test strategy covering old and new behavior while both live.
headings: Breaking-change playbook: contracts, schemas, and formats
6. Required extra section in the developer's delivery
skills.description_zh: 在 API、响应、数据库、持久格式、事件消息或其他消费接口改变时，盘点消费者、确定兼容扩展/扩展收缩/版本策略，安排迁移回填和废弃路径，并测试新旧共存行为。

skills.name: build
skills.description: Delivery pipeline from a closed spec — validates the spec mechanically (verifiable acceptance criteria, explicit excluded scope), then runs UX (if user-facing) → developer → tester ∥ auditor → findings loop → documentator, verifying each acceptance criterion from the spec. Use when the user asks to build/implement a spec file, typically one produced by /squad:define.
skills.description_zh: 从已封闭规格开展交付，机械核验可验证验收和排除范围，按需要执行 UX、开发、并行测试审计、发现修复循环和文档，逐项验证。适用于实现规格文件。

skills.name: define
skills.description: Conversational spec mode — the main session interviews the user, round by round, until the product definition closes; then writes a spec file with verifiable acceptance criteria, ready for /squad:build. Use when the user wants to define, spec, or shape a feature or product, or when a request is too vague to build directly. Also resumes/revises an existing spec file.
skills.description_zh: 主会话逐轮访谈直至产品定义封闭，编写带可验证验收的规格供 squad:build，也支持恢复修订已有规格。适用于模糊需求和功能定义。

skills.name: final-validation
skills.description: Use before delivering ANY code change to choose and run final validation — the smallest set of build/test/lint targets that covers the real risk of the change, run at the end (not after every tiny edit), never running test commands in parallel, and reporting targets executed, results, and selection rationale.
skills.description_zh: 在代码交付前选择覆盖真实风险的最小最终构建/测试/lint 集合，在末尾执行而非每次小改后，禁止并行测试，并报告目标、结果及选择理由。

skills.name: fix
skills.description: Bug-fix pipeline, reproduce-first — the tester captures the bug as a failing test BEFORE the developer may touch production code, then verifies the fix and scans for sibling occurrences of the same defect. Accepts an informal report or a screenshot and clarifies interactively in the main session first; when the bug genuinely cannot be reproduced up front, falls back to writing the regression test right after the fix. Use when the user reports a bug, regression, or broken behavior and wants the team to fix it.
headings: Intake (main session, only when the report is informal)
skills.description_zh: 接收缺陷报告或截图并澄清，测试人员先写失败复现才允许开发修改生产代码，修复后验证并扫描同类。确实不能预先复现时，修复后立即补回归测试。

skills.name: refactor
skills.description: Behavior-preserving restructuring — the existing tests become the frozen invariant that must pass identically before and after, the developer restructures without touching them, and the auditor judges whether the new structure is actually better. Use when the user wants to refactor, restructure, extract, centralize, simplify, or pay down technical debt WITHOUT changing behavior.
skills.description_zh: 在不改变行为的前提下重构、提取、集中或简化代码，既有测试冻结且前后完全通过，开发者不得修改这些测试，由审计者判断结构是否改善。

skills.name: review
skills.description: Read-only team review of a diff, branch, or PR — the auditor (security, structure), tester (contract protection, coverage gaps), and ux (only if user-facing surfaces change) review in parallel; findings are merged, deduplicated, severity-ranked, and delivered with a verdict. Nothing is modified. Use when the user asks the team to review changes without implementing anything.
skills.description_zh: 并行安排审计、测试及按需 UX 对差异、分支和 PR 只读评审，合并去重并按严重程度输出发现及结论，不修改文件。

skills.name: semantic-architecture
skills.description: Apply when a task involves active/inactive states, archiving, visibility or lifecycle; lists reused between management and operational contexts; shared selectors (comboboxes, pickers, multi-selects); different rules for "can be viewed" vs "can be used"; write-path validations that depend on state; or operational filters reused across screens. Enforces closing the semantic architecture — shared base function, semantic wrappers, backend write guard, history handling — and forbids duplicated filtering logic.
headings: Semantic architecture for changes with state, operational filters, or reuse
8. Required extra sections in the developer's delivery
skills.description_zh: 为启停归档、可见性和生命周期、管理操作列表及选择器区分可查看与可使用规则，统一基础函数、语义包装、后端写入校验及历史处理，禁止重复过滤逻辑。
